command: python3 dev/toy/test-resume-ask.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: #812: the worker's release step does not merge a goal set to ask"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-govern-notes.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: #2850: a Write outside every repo passes"

command: bash dev/toy/test-owed.sh 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: pr waits on owed off-platform proof and spends no try"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-tokens-unread.py

command: python3 dev/toy/test-no-usage.py 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-command-reference.py 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-runbook-link.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: an Output naming a Deployments row that does not exist is refused, naming it"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-package-gate.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: control: more than 99 files fails the package"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-package-gate.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: head: this checkout's package passes the file and script checks"
description: Given the merged head of a pull request, when package.py's file and script checks run on its tracked files, then the lane fails if a script is over 20,480 bytes, the package has over 99 files, or a script is not standalone; it runs on Windows too.

command: python3 dev/toy/test-publish-tables.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: after rerender no STALE Tests"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-backlog.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: the Adoption group warns for the one missing milestone"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-backlog.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: file opens one size finding labelled backlog on Backlog: Calc"

command: python3 dev/toy/test-backlog.py 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: a second ship files nothing again"
